faqs.a: Six schemes: analogous, complementary, triadic, split-complementary, square and monochromatic — five swatches each, computed from your color's position on the color wheel.
Yes. Analogous schemes use colors next to each other on the wheel, so they always blend smoothly. Complementary and triadic schemes give stronger contrast.
